customize.name: Tartaglia
customize.desc: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

customize.text: Voice-Over

<color=#ffd780>About Damselette</color>
The Fatui Harbingers are ranked by strength, and I have no idea why that girl is No. 3. I'd test my skills with every Harbinger who ranks above me if I had the chance, but when it comes to her... something just doesn't feel right. Anyway, you should be careful around her.

customize.name: Scaramouche
customize.desc: The former sixth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, created by Raiden Ei.

customize.name: Wanderer
customize.desc: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

customize.text: Voice-Over

<color=#ffd780>About Damselette</color>
Let me ask: what should you do if you were to encounter a "damsel" who is oblivious and innocent at any given time, and unconcerned and unfeeling in any given situation? If it were me, I could at least challenge her to a fight. But if it were you... with your conscience, I would stay away from her.

customize.name: Arlecchino
customize.desc: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

customize.text: Voice-Over

<color=#ffd780>About Damselette</color>
She is a very special Harbinger. Pose her a question, and the answer you receive will be entirely unpredictable, if she sees fit to give a proper answer at all. Regardless, any answer you do receive is sure to be an interesting one.

customize.name: Frostmoon Scions
customize.desc: The descendants of the legendary golden realm, who chose to find new homes among the mountains and forests after abandoning all civilization. The only thing they never forsook was their faith in the "Moon Goddess."

customize.text: <color=#ffffff73>The Frostmoon Scions consider Columbina their Moon Goddess, Kuutar. Because of their greed and doubt, Columbina left them. When</color>

customize.desc: Kuuvahki is a type of native Nod-Krai magnetism-like energy, polarized not by positive and negative, but by red and blue.

customize.text: Columbina's physical body, scattered over Nod-Krai and transformed into power.

customize.name: Fatui

customize.desc: Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya is the Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya.

A part of Columbina's soul that she left in Nod-Krai as an anchor to be reborn.

customize.name: Rerir
customize.desc: One of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, also known as "Rächer of Solnari."

customize.text: The Rächer of Solnari wanted to destroy Columbina because of her connection to the Frost Moon. By harnessing the power of all three Moons, Columbina was able to open the Moon Gate and send Rerir there.

customize.name: Il Dottore
customize.desc: The Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, codenamed The Doctor. Had multiple "segments" of himself, nearly all of which he destroyed in a deal with the Dendro Archon. His real name is Zandik.

customize.name: The Doctor
customize.desc:
Reviled far and wide as a heretic, The Doctor — Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers — has seized the authority of the three moons and now ascends the long steps toward the divine throne of the "new world."
All should have belonged to us.
But reason cast out all that exceeded its limits, leaving humanity blind to its true nature.
Life and death bound us into mortal shells, shackling every spark of aspiration.
Time and space closed in last of all, fencing the mind into meek obedience, so no one would dare imagine breaking free.
From that point on, false gods governed the world, each one declaring their own truth as the sole, unassailable gospel — though none deserved the mantle they so loudly coveted.
There is no inherent structure to life's flow — order was merely imposed upon it. Strip away every shackle laid across this world, and the essence of all things will at last come into view.
And that revelation... is the first light of the new world.
"How much longer will you continue to suffer this stagnant, obsolescent world?"

customize.text:
The Fatui Harbinger decided to subjugate the power of the Three Moons and obtained the Iridescent Moon's marrow, the Eternal Moon's marrow by deception, and locked up Columbina. To prevent him from using her power, Columbina opened the Moon Gate and stepped into the space beyond it.
When Columbina became the Goddess of the Three Moons, she defeated The Doctor.

customize.name: Sandrone
customize.desc: The Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as Marionette.

customize.text:
Columbina's friend and former colleague. When Columbina was in the Moon's reflection, Sandrone used the world-formula to calculate her location and bring her back.
When Sandrone was destroyed during the battle with Dottore, Columbina attempted to use the power of the Three Moons to bring her back.

customize.name: Arlecchino
customize.desc: The Fourth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, known as The Knave. Her real name is Peruere.

customize.text: Columbina's friend and former colleague. Arlecchino helped Columbina obtain the Iridescenscent Moon's marrow to defeat the Rächer of Solnari. Afterward, the Moon Goddess gave the moon marrow to Arlecchino.

customize.name: Lauma
customize.desc: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

customize.text: The Frostmoon Scions' Moonchanter and Columbina's friend. Columbina gave her the Eternal Moon's marrow.

customize.text: Related Books and Items

customize.name: Greeting Card for Columbina
customize.desc: A greeting card prepared by Columbina's companions for Moon-Prayer Night. It carries their heartfelt wishes, hoping that wherever she is, she will remember the smiles they shared tonight.

customize.name: Moon-Prayer Night Pamphlet
customize.desc: A pamphlet handed out at Nasha Town's Moon-Prayer Night. It highlights a variety of fun booths and activities. With it in hand, guests are sure to enjoy an evening they won't soon forget.

customize.name: Moon-Prayer Candy From Columbina
customize.desc: A Moon-Prayer Candy made by Columbina for everyone to enjoy. Inspired by her boundless imagination, this candy holds a wide variety of surprising flavors, perhaps drawn from the tastes she remembers most fondly.

customize.name: Sugar Sculpture: Kuuhenki
customize.desc: A sugar sculpture modeled after a mysterious creature. With an ethereal form, it's a kuuhenki drifting gently in the moonlight.

customize.name: Sugar Sculpture: Columbina
customize.desc: A sugar sculpture crafted to capture a person's essence. Its light, fluttering hair ornaments bring to mind Columbina, the Moon Maiden, whose very presence feels as airy as a gentle song.

customize.name: Moon-Prayer Blossom From Columbina
customize.desc:
A Moon-Prayer Blossom gifted to you by Columbina, exuding a fragrance both pure and ethereal, much like those you once saw in the Silvermoon Hall.
It stirs the memory of a story, and heralds the opening of a new chapter. This time, it will never lose its colors again.

customize.name: Nocturne's Curtain Call
customize.desc: A jade pearl shrouded in the light of the moon. Even in the coldest winter night, its gentle warmth lingers like a song.
